exports: reclaimContentStaging(root: string, options: {jobIds: string[], expectedPlanId?: string, signal?: AbortSignal}): Promise<ContentStorageCleanupResult>
usage: inspect root -> plan.planId and plan.jobIds -> reclaim(root,{jobIds,expectedPlanId:plan.planId}); each selected file revalidated under shared maintenance mutex; inspect again after apply for UI.
hook: After runJobs releases worker mutex, select completed/partial entries with reclaimable files, then use this module. Busy, changed plans or cancellation retain remaining copies; do not nest the maintenance lock.
constraints: no actual library deletion by this conversation
no source edits outside the new storage module and its isolated tests
only per-file exact capturePath mapping, status saved, bytes and SHA coverage; no basename guessing
no recursive deletion; empty directory pruning only along successfully reclaimed file parents
shared worker mutex plus fresh queue/manifest/file checks before each unlink
no credentials, signed URLs or browser profile content emitted
